quests.complete: Nessa smooths the receipt flat. “Paid. Witnessed. Recorded. My father would say that should be enough. I shall endeavour to make him right.”

quests.name: Supper at the Last Oar
quests.summary: Bring three trail loaves to Jory at the Last Oar. You may use your own bread or buy it at his counter.
quests.offer: “Jory has boatmen waiting out the damp. Take three loaves to the Last Oar. Bread from your bag is bread enough. Then sit down before he tells everyone I have been forgetting to eat again.”
quests.progress: Bring three trail loaves to Jory at the Last Oar. You may use your own bread or buy it at his counter.
quests.complete: Jory finds a dry stool. “You have met the family, then. Yes, all of us. There are beds upstairs, and you can make this your home while you are working the river. The roof leaks in one highly traditional place.”

objectives.label: Bring three loaves to the waiting boatmen
Speak to Jory at the Last Oar

quests.name: A Fire Between Two Roads
quests.summary: Follow the ridge lamps to Sergeant Sella at Lamplighter’s Rest, between the crossing and ferry roads.
quests.offer: “Merrit’s crossing or Nessa’s landing. Either account tells me enough to act. Come closer to the fire and tell me what you saw. The collectors have moved from fares to mine wages, and the men keeping the lamps have started disappearing.”
quests.progress: Follow the ridge lamps to Sergeant Sella at Lamplighter’s Rest, between the crossing and ferry roads.
quests.complete: Sella marks the copied seal. “That will stand up. We will get the miners out, collect the original accounts and send a witness to Rillbank. One job at a time. I am told that is a Thornford tradition.”

objectives.label: Bring the local witness account to Sella

quests.name: For the People Still Waiting
quests.summary: Gather four bundles beside Sella’s camp, then follow the short east path to Edda at the miners’ rest.
quests.offer: “Four bundles of dry wood from our reserve. Edda is keeping the miners’ families at the next camp east. Take them there and ask her for the shift tally. They need a warm evening before they need another speech.”
quests.progress: Gather four bundles beside Sella’s camp, then follow the short east path to Edda at the miners’ rest.
quests.complete: Edda takes the wood first. “Useful. You can ask me anything now.” She finds a folded tally. “These are the shifts they worked. These are the wages they received. You will notice I have needed much less paper for the second list.”

objectives.label: Gather four dry bundles for the miners’ camp

quests.name: Room to Turn
quests.summary: Use the broad lime-cut path toward Blackpick. Defeat four wardens and return to Edda. Move out of their marked heavy swings.
quests.offer: “The wardens block the lime cut. Four of them. Their heavy swing is easy to see coming if you have room to move. Take the broad shelf, step clear when they draw back, then return here. A clever fight is one you can still walk away from.”
quests.progress: Use the broad lime-cut path toward Blackpick. Defeat four wardens and return to Edda. Move out of their marked heavy swings.
quests.complete: Edda checks your hands for shaking. “Good. A road we can use. We should have hired you before they hired a bailiff.” She gives you a work cloak from the dry chest.

quests.name: Work Already Done
quests.summary: Recover the three marked wage tags along the quarry approach, then take them to Sella’s fire.
quests.offer: “The old tags are tied along the cut. Three with settled wages, if Corven has not burned them. Bring those to Sella. They are proof our people were workers, not debtors handed down with the tools.”
quests.progress: Recover the three marked wage tags along the quarry approach, then take them to Sella’s fire.
quests.complete: Sella lays the tags in a row. “Settled. Settled. Settled. There is very little ambiguity here. Corven has kept the original ledger at his desk. We are finished asking him politely.”

quests.name: The Bailiff’s Last Shift
quests.summary: Prepare at camp, then confront Bailiff Corven on Blackpick’s outer approach. Step clear of his marked swing, read the ledger and return to Edda.
quests.offer: “Corven is at the mine’s outer desk. Defeat him and read the altered ledger, then report to Edda. Watch his marked swing and keep a way back to the open shelf. You have food, a draught and time to prepare. Use them.”
quests.progress: Prepare at camp, then confront Bailiff Corven on Blackpick’s outer approach. Step clear of his marked swing, read the ledger and return to Edda.
quests.complete: Edda closes her eyes for a moment. “Then my people can come home.” She straightens the wage tags. “I will see them paid. That part was always my job.”

quests.name: A Name Beneath the Statement
quests.summary: Recover the ledger from the cleared desk, then take it to Merrit at Lantern Crossing.
quests.offer: “The book is still at his desk. Take it to Merrit with my name beneath the statement. I signed the old wage agreement because my people were hungry. I am signing this because I mean to answer for what happens next.”
quests.progress: Recover the ledger from the cleared desk, then take it to Merrit at Lantern Crossing.
quests.complete: Merrit reads Edda’s signature. “We have witnesses from Thornford, a local account and the original book. Rillbank cannot call this a misplaced invoice. There is a place for your name too, if you are willing to carry it.”

quests.name: Beyond the Last Familiar Lamp
quests.summary: Follow the trade road southeast from Lantern Crossing to Rillbank Quays. Deliver the sealed account to the quay officer.
quests.offer: “Take this to the quay office in Rillbank, southeast along the trade road. You arrived in Thornford looking for a meal. Now three communities have put their names beside yours. That is how a reputation begins. Try to keep it useful.”
quests.progress: Follow the trade road southeast from Lantern Crossing to Rillbank Quays. Deliver the sealed account to the quay officer.
quests.complete: The quay officer breaks the seal. “Thornford. Mossreed or the crossing. Blackpick.” A second chair is pulled up to the desk. “We have heard rumours. This is considerably better than a rumour. Welcome to Rillbank. We have work worthy of a witness.”

objectives.label: Deliver the witness account at Rillbank Quays

quests.name: An Agreement Between Neighbours
quests.summary: Hear Heda and Osric at the orchard boundary, then return to Alder to settle the dispute.
quests.offer: “Hear both neighbours. Then, if you can get them to share the repair, I will witness their agreement. We can spend the saved coin on something less argumentative.”
quests.progress: Hear Heda and Osric at the orchard boundary, then return to Alder to settle the dispute.
quests.complete: “We split the repair timber and leave the old stone where it stood.” Heda offers her hand. Osric takes it. Neither looks delighted, which Alder considers encouraging.

quests.name: The Mayor’s Measure
quests.summary: Hear Heda and Osric at the orchard boundary, then return to Alder to settle the dispute.
quests.offer: “Hear both neighbours. Then bring the matter back to my measure. The village will pay for the repair, and both households will receive a written boundary.”
quests.progress: Hear Heda and Osric at the orchard boundary, then return to Alder to settle the dispute.
quests.complete: Alder sets his stamped measure against the old stone. “The boundary stays here. The repair costs go on the village account.” Heda accepts the ruling. Osric asks for his copy in writing.

quests.name: A Calling
quests.summary: Speak to Morrow Finch outside Mourning Hollow’s apothecary.
quests.offer: “Morrow teaches spellcraft as well as medicine. He says both trades suffer from people rushing the important bit. Find him in Mourning Hollow if you would like a proper lesson.”
quests.progress: Speak to Morrow Finch outside Mourning Hollow’s apothecary.
quests.complete: “A Wizard. Good. Someone who may yet learn that a frozen kettle is not the end of a cook’s problems.”

quests.name: A Proper Thaw
quests.summary: Practise Frost Lance followed by Firebolt twice in Nameless Yard, then return to Morrow.
quests.offer: “In the yard, cast Frost Lance, then Firebolt on the same target. Do that twice. The steam is the lesson. Return when you can explain what changed. I will accept a concise answer; I still have the surgery to open.”
quests.progress: Practise Frost Lance followed by Firebolt twice in Nameless Yard, then return to Morrow.
quests.complete: “You changed what the second spell found. Keep thinking that way.” Morrow offers a balanced athame. “A tool worth looking after. Open your bags and equip it before your next experiment.”

objectives.label: Chill two targets with Frost Lance
